description: Read the Lifecycle tool (@buoy-gg/lifecycle): the app's simulated and real app state, how many of the APP's own listeners each lifecycle signal has (app state, memory warning, deep link, battery), the report of what the app did during and after the last simulation (requests, query refetches, route changes, store writes, with a finding such as requests made while in the background), and the relaunch check (did the app reopen where it was). Read it after lifecycle_action; reports keep collecting for a few seconds after the app returns.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

name: get_lifecycle
